## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the problem they resolve.

Closes # (issue number if applicable)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance optimization (improves latency, rendering, or memory)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code style cleanup

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and formatting standards.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run check` and confirmed **0 warnings / 0 errors**.
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` and all unit tests pass.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run benchmark` if touching parser or rendering performance.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `/docs` if introducing new features or syntax.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
